I bought salami and cheese sandwiches plus a Baggio juice for $8800. I thought it was a bit expensive, but the worst part was that they were expired. Also, I couldn't pay with the YPF app. And the restrooms weren't very clean.

reviews.comment:
Hace 5 años que vamos a Villa Nueva, Córdoba, y siempre hacemos nuestra última parada acá, la atención del muchacho y la chica del minisuper es excelente, los sanguchitos de cocido, salame riquísimos, y más si le untan manteca, los recomiendo, el café con leche riquísimo, da gusto parar un rato y más charlar con ellos que son muy buena onda, muy atentos, éxitos chicos 🫶🏼

(Translated by Google)
We've been going to Villa Nueva, Córdoba for 5 years now, and we always make our last stop here. The service from the guy and girl at the mini-market is excellent, the stew sandwiches and salami are delicious, especially with butter. I highly recommend them. The coffee with milk is also delicious. It's a pleasure to stop for a while and even more so to chat with them; they're really friendly and attentive. Best of luck, guys! 🫶🏼

reviewReply.comment: Muchas gracias Ivana por su visita y puntuación.
